caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bucket or pail with a dark, curved handle attached at each side near its rim. The body of the bucket is primarily dark green in color, with a slightly reflective or metallic texture, and appears cylindrical, tapering slightly toward the base. On the front is a prominent oval emblem with a beige or light tan background, bordered in blue and green, containing the large black letters "C.F.S." and the black numerals "1813" underneath. Above the emblem, there is a banner with the partially visible words “THE ABBOTT” in dark letters on a light blue background. At the top of the bucket, above the banner, there is a painted image of an eagle with outstretched wings rendered in brown and gold. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light beige color, with no other objects or details present.
title: Fire Bucket
